scientific_integrity: The stated spectrum and sharp finite-horizon comparison have exact two-by-two proofs. Finite tests are consistency checks and are not substitutes for universal reasoning.
scientific_limitations: Common relaxation, equally spaced planar affine-line directions, exact arithmetic, full cycles; comparisons relative to each parameter-dependent fixed point. No general nonconvex convergence or objective-optimality assertion.
title: An exact relaxation-invariant spectrum and a finite-horizon reversal for cyclic relaxed Douglas–Rachford on a regular line fan
